raw_text:
Scheme Name: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth
Fund House: HDFC Mutual Fund
Source URL: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/hdfc-elss-tax-saver-fund-direct-plan-growth
Category: Equity - ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme)
Plan Type: Direct Plan - Growth Option
Net Asset Value (NAV): ₹1,546.95 as of mid-November 2026 (subject to daily fluctuation at market close).
Lock-in Period: 3 Years mandatory statutory lock-in period from the date of allotment. For SIP investments, each individual monthly installment has an independent 3-year lock-in period and cannot be withdrawn or switched out before 36 months.
Tax Benefit / Deduction: Investments in this scheme are eligible for tax deductions of up to ₹1.5 Lakh in a financial year under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, 1961 (applicable under the Old Tax Regime).
Expense Ratio: 1.18% (inclusive of GST, as published on official scheme factsheet).
Exit Load: Nil. There is zero exit load after completion of the 3-year statutory lock-in period. Units cannot be redeemed before 3 years under any circumstances.
Minimum SIP Investment: ₹500 per installment (in multiples of ₹500).
Minimum Lumpsum Investment: ₹500 (in multiples of ₹500).
Riskometer Level: Very High Risk. Investors understand that their principal will be at very high risk.
Benchmark: NIFTY 500 Total Return Index (TRI).
Tax Implications upon Withdrawal: Capital gains upon redemption after 3 years are treated as Long Term Capital Gains (LTCG) and are taxed at 12.5% on capital gains exceeding ₹1.25 Lakh per financial year.
Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA): CAMS (Computer Age Management Services Ltd.), website: www.camsonline.com.
Last updated from sources: November 2026.
